stem: A 76-year-old started oxybutynin 3 weeks ago. Her family reports dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision and new forgetfulness. What links all four?
A 26-year-old has used DMPA injections for 4 years and wants to continue long term. She has irregular spotting and asks about any lasting risks. Which point should be covered?
A 67-year-old with stable angina takes isosorbide mononitrate daily and asks for sildenafil. Which response matches the lecture?
A 64-year-old with blood pressure 168/102 despite two drugs is offered mirabegron for overactive bladder. He also takes a drug cleared by CYP2D6. Which two cautions apply?
A 58-year-old has taken tamoxifen for 3 years after breast cancer. She mentions light vaginal spotting for 2 weeks and wonders whether to wait until her next annual visit. What is the best response?
A 62-year-old takes tamsulosin for BPH and wants to start tadalafil for erectile dysfunction. He takes no nitrates. Which statement is correct?
A 23-year-old started a progestin-only pill 6 weeks ago and has unpredictable spotting. She is worried something is wrong. What is the best counseling?
A 29-year-old with PCOS starts metformin. After 5 days she has nausea and loose stools and wants to stop. Her renal function is normal. What is the best advice?
A 59-year-old on sildenafil starts ketoconazole. After his next dose he has a pounding headache, marked flushing and a blue tint to his vision. What explains the stronger effects?
A 44-year-old premenopausal woman with estrogen receptor–positive breast cancer asks why she was not given anastrozole alone like her 68-year-old aunt. Which explanation is correct?
A 31-year-old man using testosterone from a gym contact has been trying to conceive for a year. Semen analysis shows a very low sperm count. What is the mechanism?
A 27-year-old with PCOS takes spironolactone for hirsutism. She is started on lisinopril for hypertension. Which monitoring matters most?
A 68-year-old has taken dutasteride for 3 years. His PSA was 3.0 ng/mL before treatment and is 2.6 ng/mL now. How should the PA interpret this?
An 82-year-old with mild dementia on donepezil has urge incontinence. She also takes diphenhydramine nightly. Her blood pressure is well controlled. Which plan is best?
Which description of tamoxifen's tissue actions matches the study guide?
A 59-year-old on finasteride for 8 months reports lower libido and erectile difficulty. His urinary flow is better. Which statement is correct?
Two women take a SERM. One takes tamoxifen after breast cancer; the other takes raloxifene for osteoporosis. Which risk do both drugs share, and which belongs to only one?
A 70-year-old stable on solifenacin starts clarithromycin. Four days later he has a very dry mouth, constipation and blurred vision. What is the mechanism?
A 38-year-old who smokes a pack a day asks for 'the regular pill' for contraception. Her mother had a pulmonary embolism at 45. Which option is most appropriate?
A 55-year-old wants an erectile dysfunction drug that does not need to be timed closely to activity. He takes no nitrates or alpha blockers. Which choice and reason match the lecture?
A 22-year-old on a combined pill starts carbamazepine for a seizure disorder and St. John's wort on her own. Which statement is correct?
A 53-year-old with severe hot flashes has an intact uterus. A 55-year-old with the same symptoms had a hysterectomy. Which regimens match the lecture's rule?
A 33-year-old with PCOS and an eGFR of 28 from lupus nephritis is being considered for metformin. What is the main concern?
A 71-year-old starts tamsulosin for BPH and is scheduled for cataract surgery next month. He also takes two antihypertensives. Which pair of counseling points is correct?
A man with advanced prostate cancer receives leuprolide together with bicalutamide. Which description of the pair matches the lecture?
A man has both urgency with small frequent voids and a weak stream with hesitancy. Which pairing of drug, site and problem treated is correct?
A 61-year-old on warfarin for atrial fibrillation starts testosterone gel for confirmed hypogonadism. Which monitoring set is most complete for the first months?
A 69-year-old on amitriptyline for neuropathic pain is started on solifenacin. He becomes confused and cannot pass urine easily. Which explanation fits?
A 66-year-old on letrozole for 18 months reports aching in her hands and knees. Her DXA scan shows a drop in bone density. Which plan fits the lecture?
A 64-year-old on stable warfarin starts tamoxifen. Three weeks later she has nosebleeds and bruising. Which mechanism does the lecture give?
